legs.summary: POINT OF NO RETURN: Burning the Erdtree at the Forge of the Giants sends you here automatically and permanently transforms Leyndell into the Ashen Capital. All Royal Capital-exclusive items (specifically flagged missable in region 12-leyndell) are now locked out forever. You wake on a bridge in Farum Azula and must push forward. Explore the Beast Grave section for early loot before descending.

steps.text: WARNING — POINT OF NO RETURN: Speaking to Melina at the Forge of the Giants and burning the Erdtree is IRREVERSIBLE. All items in Leyndell, Royal Capital that were flagged as missable 'lockedBy: Burning the Erdtree' are now permanently inaccessible. Ensure you have collected everything in Leyndell, completed the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (Frenzied Flame Proscription), and completed Dung Eater's questline before proceeding.

You awaken on the Crumbling Beast Grave bridge. Activate the Site of Grace, then descend into the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths. The region is a maze of floating ruins in a tempestuous sky — stay methodical.

steps.note: Found at ground level in the middle of the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths Site of Grace. Give to Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows to unlock Ancient Dragons' Lightning Spear and Ancient Dragons' Lightning Strike incantations.
Dropped by large Beastmen (curved greatsword variant) patrolling the Beast Grave exterior and interior areas. Farm the enemies near the Crumbling Beast Grave grace for both beastman weapons.
Dropped by smaller Beastmen throughout the region. Both weapons have a reasonable drop rate from the common enemies here.

legs.summary: Ascend through the Dragon Temple complex. The main hall holds the Godskin Duo boss fight — a mandatory encounter on the critical path. Recusant Bernahl's cooperative summon sign appears near the Dragon Temple grace if you completed the Volcano Manor questline through defeating Rykard (specifically after receiving Gelmir's Fury). The Godskin Duo drops two bell bearings essential for weapon upgrading.

steps.text: From Beast Grave Depths, navigate west and north through the flooded lower areas, ascending into the Dragon Temple proper. Activate the Dragon Temple Site of Grace.

steps.note: From the Dragon Temple Site of Grace, drop down facing west and then jump to the bottom level of the temple. These ashes are on a body at the bottom level of the Dragon Temple.
From Dragon Temple grace, head inside the temple east into a semi-open back area — corpse holds the key.

steps.text: Recusant Bernahl's gold summon sign appears near the Dragon Temple Site of Grace if you completed the Volcano Manor questline (received Gelmir's Fury after defeating Vargram and Wilhelm, then defeated Rykard). You may summon him to assist in the Godskin Duo fight. His invasion later (dropping Blasphemous Claw, Devourer's Scepter, and Beast Champion set — items pre-placed in 11-mt-gelmir for progression tracking) triggers at the Great Bridge walkway after crossing north.

Godskin Duo — fought in the main hall of the Dragon Temple interior. Two simultaneous enemies: Godskin Noble and Godskin Apostle. Bernahl can be summoned as an ally if questline was completed. A boss mist resets the HP on one when the other dies — killing both quickly (or sleeping them with St. Trina's Arrow) prevents this.

steps.note: Dropped by the Godskin Duo upon defeat — unlocks Smithing Stone [7] and [8] purchasing at Twin Maiden Husks in Roundtable Hold. (Note: item name says [4] but it unlocks tiers 7-8 per game data.)
Also dropped by the Godskin Duo — unlocks Somber Smithing Stone [7] and [8] at Twin Maiden Husks.
Dropped by the Godskin Duo on defeat. Excellent Ash of War for Faith/Strength builds.

legs.summary: Explore the elevated Dragon Temple sections and surrounding cliffs for high-value loot: two upgraded talismans (Boltdrake +2, Dragoncrest Shield +2), the Dragon Towershield, a cookbook, an incantation, two Golden Seeds, the Somberstone Bell Bearing [5], and the Old Lord's Talisman chest. Then reach the hidden Placidusax boss by descending the platforms below Beside the Great Bridge and lying down at the marked archway. Miquella's Needle can be used inside this arena to undo the Frenzied Flame.

steps.text: From Dragon Temple Altar, take the lift up to Dragon Temple Lift, then Dragon Temple Rooftop. Explore all side paths before the main route — significant loot is hidden in the elevated and cliff sections.

steps.note: Found on a corpse hanging off an opening in a tall tower south of Dragon Temple Rooftop Site of Grace. Requires careful platforming/jumping down the east-side cliff of that tower.
Found on a corpse on a chunk of floating debris in the north. From Dragon Temple Lift grace, take the lift up and navigate the floating rocks north.
In a chest in the terrace section of a building far to the bottom of the plaza southeast from the Dragon Temple Rooftop Site of Grace.
In a gazebo-like structure high above in the heavily-crumbled northwest section. Ascend the Dragon Temple stairs then navigate the crumbled upper paths northwest.
Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab by the cliffs south of the fountain plaza in the upper area after ascending Dragon Temple stairs.
Under a Phantom Tree by some pillars south of the fountain plaza. In the upper area accessed after ascending Dragon Temple stairs.
Under a Phantom Tree amongst several sets of pillar structures on a hill in the plaza southeast from the Dragon Temple Rooftop Site of Grace.
Found on a corpse sitting in front of an altar right at the entrance to the building with the Beside the Great Bridge Site of Grace.

steps.text: Activate Beside the Great Bridge Site of Grace. Then retrieve the Old Lord's Talisman: head north across the bridge and enter the building at the far north end. Exit onto the balcony on the right and take the ladder down to a walkway. The talisman chest is in a rotunda at the end — CAUTION: Recusant Bernahl invades on this walkway if you completed his questline (this is where his invasion loot drops from 11-mt-gelmir reference). Fight or lure him off the cliff, then loot the chest.

Collect the Old Lord's Talisman (pre-placed in region 11-mt-gelmir): chest in a rotunda on the east edge of the Dragon Temple Rooftop, accessible by heading north from the Great Bridge, entering the building, exiting onto the balcony, and taking the ladder. Recusant Bernahl invades on this walkway if his questline was completed (his drops are tracked in 11-mt-gelmir).

To reach Dragonlord Placidusax: from Beside the Great Bridge grace, do NOT cross the bridge. Instead drop down the left (south) side onto descending platforms. Look for a windswept archway on the ground — when you stand near the 'lie down' prompt appears. This is Placidusax's hidden fog gate. The arena is a temporal void; the boss cannot be seen on approach.

If you inherited the Frenzied Flame from the Three Fingers (locking all non-Frenzied Flame endings), use Miquella's Needle as a consumable INSIDE Dragonlord Placidusax's arena BEFORE or AFTER the fight. This permanently reverses the Frenzied Flame and restores access to other endings. The needle is consumed on use. Burn marks from the Three Fingers persist cosmetically but can be removed by Rennala during character customization. Source: complete Millicent's questline to receive the Unalloyed Gold Needle in Caelid (region 06), then defeat Malenia in Elphael (region 17) and interact with the Scarlet Aeonia blossom afterward.

steps.note: Obtained by completing Millicent's questline: obtain Unalloyed Gold Needle from Gowry in Caelid (region 06), give it to Millicent at Church of the Plague, assist her vs. her sisters at Elphael (region 17), then reload and interact with Scarlet Aeonia blossom after Malenia's defeat. Use inside Placidusax's arena to undo Frenzied Flame. CONSUMED on use.

steps.text: Dragonlord Placidusax — an ancient two-headed dragon frozen in time, one of the Elden Ring's oldest entities and 'Elden Lord' of a prior age. Optional but highly recommended for the remembrance. Arena is accessed only via the lying-down prompt. Teleporting attacks can be avoided by locking on and tracking his position.

steps.note: Dropped by Dragonlord Placidusax. Trade with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for either Placidusax's Ruin (incantation) or Dragon King's Cragblade (piercing sword). Only one per playthrough unless you duplicate at Walking Mausoleums.
Trade Remembrance of the Dragonlord with Enia at Roundtable Hold. Fires an ancient dragon breath beam covering a massive area.

Alternative trade of Remembrance of the Dragonlord with Enia. Piercing sword containing primeval lightning from Placidusax. From 99-unsorted — claimed here as the Remembrance-derived weapon from this boss.

legs.summary: Explore the lower levels for the Glovewort bell bearing, then cross the Great Bridge north where Recusant Bernahl invades (loot items pre-placed in 11-mt-gelmir). Duel Iron Fist Alexander at the Dragon Temple Lift clearing for his questline conclusion. Then face Maliketh, the final boss of this region. Defeating Maliketh as Beast Clergyman teleports you to Leyndell, Ashen Capital — the final stretch begins. Gurranq at the Bestial Sanctum IS Maliketh but can still be visited for remaining Deathroot rewards even after Maliketh is defeated.

steps.text: From Tempest-Facing Balcony grace, take the lift in the terrace southwest of the grace to reach the lower area with the shallow wormface-infested pond.

steps.note: Found inside a gazebo by the shallow pond infested by Lesser Wormfaces. Reached via the lift in the terrace southwest of Tempest-Facing Balcony. Unlocks Ghost Glovewort [7] and [8] at Twin Maiden Husks.
In the room next to the Tempest-Facing Balcony Site of Grace.

steps.text: Cross the Great Bridge heading north. Before reaching the tower at the far end, watch for Recusant Bernahl's invasion (red phantom) — he invades on the path north of the bridge if you completed his questline through Rykard (having already received the Volcano Manor assignments). Items from Bernahl's drop (Blasphemous Claw, Devourer's Scepter, Beast Champion set) are tracked in 11-mt-gelmir since they require Volcano Manor quest completion context.

Find Iron Fist Alexander's location: from Dragon Temple Lift Site of Grace, head west to the large open area with collapsed archways — he stands in the clearing. Exhaust his dialogue first before initiating combat; he specifically requests a final duel.

Iron Fist Alexander's final encounter — he challenges you to a duel in the large clearing west of Dragon Temple Lift. Prerequisites: freed him from the pothole in Limgrave Stormhill (hit him), found him near Gael Tunnel, met him at Radahn Festival at Redmane Castle (Caelid), spoke with him in Liurnia above Jarburg (freed him with Oil Pot + strike), met him in Mt. Gelmir lava pool south of Fort Laiedd, optionally summoned for Fire Giant. After defeating him, he shatters and grants everything inside him.

steps.note: Dropped by Iron Fist Alexander after the final duel in Farum Azula. Greatly boosts the potency of Ashes of War skills — one of the best endgame talisman slots for skill-focused builds.
Also dropped by Iron Fist Alexander. Give to Jar-Bairn in Jarburg (Liurnia, region 04) to complete his branch of the questline — Jar-Bairn vows to grow as strong as his uncle.

steps.text: Head to the fog gate beyond the Great Bridge tower (north of Beside the Great Bridge). Maliketh reveals his true form as Beast Clergyman transforms mid-fight. Note: Gurranq, Beast Clergyman at the Bestial Sanctum in Dragonbarrow IS Maliketh in his suppressed form. Defeating Maliketh here does NOT lock out remaining Deathroot rewards — Gurranq remains at the Bestial Sanctum and continues accepting Deathroots even after Maliketh is defeated (verified on wiki.gg).

Maliketh, the Black Blade — two-phase fight: Phase 1 as Beast Clergyman (agile melee), Phase 2 as Maliketh (holy-affinity Destined Death attacks). The Blasphemous Claw (dropped by Bernahl in this region, tracked in 11-mt-gelmir) can parry his golden-glowing sword attacks. Defeating him teleports you directly to Leyndell, Ashen Capital.

steps.note: Dropped by Maliketh. Trade with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for either Black Blade incantation or Maliketh's Black Blade weapon.
Trade Remembrance of the Black Blade with Enia at Roundtable Hold. Powerful holy-affinity incantation.
Alternative trade of Remembrance of the Black Blade with Enia. Colossal sword embodying Destined Death.
